project.name: TypeSafe Core
project.description: The TypeSafe wire model (Answer, Question, Content, EvaluateRequest/EvaluateResponse, Usage, RequestId, Model, ModelDetails) and the Codec SPI. No dependencies. With a codec-* module it serializes TypeSafe payloads without any client code, e.g. for a Kafka producer/consumer; the client contract is typesafe-java-client.
